test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘CLIMATE’ is written as ‘DUZNHMD’ and ‘COMPLEX’ is written as ‘YDMQNND’. How will ‘DISPLAY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6702ce6aaa71779265fbe5a983afea9e0b09dae8a7d692fdd03b617ef2a8f6c6.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Vowels - 1 and Consonants + 1**

‘CLIMATE’ is written as ‘DUZNHMD’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/747b4bbeccc46c15e1d28d4ac0220ca044ca650f5fe7e89136ee2b1929f0cbb1.png] 

‘COMPLEX’ is written as ‘YDMQNND’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aafe2c11e99880f9daaa047c2005b8b7855f7ec1c02c002b487025edd2150aff.png] 

Similarly, ‘**DISPLAY**’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d52a906f8b070978f9de8f5219098b2fed45782d1e77ec00c6822e11dd426ae4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
